summary: Revised implementation plan for Catetin Phase 3: Transcription Workspace Redesign. Incorporates all four final requirements: (1) borderless continuous document layout with whitespace separation instead of dialogue cards, (2) strict preservation of actual App.tsx data structures (DialogSegment, SampleRecording, seconds, time) with zero invented fields, (3) accurate 3-tier hardware diagnostics distinguishing WebGPU API exposure, adapter availability, and CPU/WASM fallback with honest copy, and (4) complete preservation of all UI states (ready, loading, empty, error).
